records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近同意以 2.5 億美元的和解金結束一起指稱其在 Siri 人工智慧功能上誤導消費者的集體訴訟 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。  

- 這起訴訟由加州北區聯邦法院受理，原告指稱 Apple 在行銷「增強 Siri 功能」時，該功能尚未真正可用，導致消費者基於錯誤廣告購買 iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max 以及 iPhone 16（2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日期間）【同上】。  
- 和解金上限為 2.5 億美元，符合條件的約 3,700 萬部 iPhone 用戶將先收到每部手機 25 美元的賠償，最終金額最高可達每部 95 美元【同上】。  
- Apple 表示此和解旨在「讓我們專注於做好最擅長的事——為用戶提供最創新的產品與服務」【同上】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by

contributed to this report.

After two years of delays, Apple's (

) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布將於今年秋季以測試版形式推出全新 **Siri AI**，這版 Siri 會結合 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型，並透過 Apple Intelligence 取得應用程式上下文與更安全的個人化服務【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- **AI 核心技術**：Apple 與 Google 簽署協議，使用 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 以及 Image 模型為 Siri 提供推理能力，同時利用 Google Search 作為知識基礎，但 Apple 不會使用 Google 向客戶提供的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- **功能亮點**：Siri AI 能從使用者的 App 中抽取上下文，例如直接回應「我妹妹在訊息裡推薦的播客是什麼？」而不必先開啟相關 App；新推出的 Siri App 讓所有對話集中管理，強調安全與隱私【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **推出時程**：目前仍是 beta 版，預計今年秋季在美國以英語先行上線，屆時會在 iOS 系統內提供語音輸入、問答與第三方 App 自動化等功能【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **市場定位**：Apple 希望透過這次升級讓 Siri 能與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭對手抗衡，同時利用 AI 提升 iPhone 的銷售動能，過去四季 iPhone 成長率已達 16%【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Apple 在 WWDC 公布的 Siri 新消息是：全新 AI 驅動的 Siri AI 以 Google Gemini 為底層模型、整合 Apple Intelligence、提供更深度的上下文與隱私保護，將於今年秋季以測試版在美國先行推出。

records.answer:

- Apple Intelligence 功能在各設備上持續擴散，預期將帶來多年度升級、提升貨幣化能力與擴大經常性收入，進一步鞏固長期營收基礎【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。

records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽下了一系列多億美元的 AI 基礎設施合作協議，包括一份 5 年期、價值 **$3.4 billion** 的 AI Cloud 合約以及一項最高 **$2.1 billion** 的投資權利，這些投資會隨著 NVIDIA GPU 在 IREN 數據中心的部署而逐步解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

- 合約規模：IREN 將在 2026‑2027 年內部署約 **60 MW** 的空冷 Blackwell GPU 設備，並在 2026 年目標建設 **480 MW**、約 **150,000 GPUs**，到 2026 年底實現 **$3.7 billion** 的 ARR，2027 年則擴張至 **1,210 MW**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 投資結構：NVIDIA 獲得一項為期五年的認購權，可以每股 **$70** 的價格購買最多 **30 million** 普通股，若全部行使將代表 **$2.1 billion** 的潛在投資；此投資僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施部署完成後才會全部生效，最終完全解鎖需部署 **600,000 GPUs**【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 能源與算力基礎：IREN 已將受保電力提升至 **5 GW**，並計畫在 2026 年內完成 **150,000 GPUs** 的部署，支撐 AI Cloud 服務的快速擴張【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 財務影響：該 AI Cloud 合約已產生約 **$700 million** 的 ARR，與 IREN 目前的 **$3.1 billion** ARR 目標相呼應，顯示雙方合作正從比特幣礦業向 AI 計算服務轉型【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

總結來說，NVIDIA 與 IREN 的最新合作結合了巨額 AI Cloud 合約、以 GPU 部署為條件的投資認購權，以及大規模電力與算力建設，旨在將 IREN 的電力資產快速轉化為 AI 計算供給，並為 NVIDIA 提供長期 GPU 部署市場。

- **AMD** 正在開發一套可與 Nvidia 競爭的機架級伺服器系統，預計於今年晚些時候上市，進一步加劇晶片市場的競爭格局【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **Amazon** 與 **Google** 作為 Nvidia 的大客戶，已開始向第三方客戶提供自家 AI 晶片。Amazon 在最新財報中透露，其晶片業務的年收入跑道已超過 **$20 billion**，且以 **三位數百分比** 的年增速成長，顯示其自研晶片正快速擴張【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 整體而言，Nvidia 的財報被視為 **AI 晶片市場的風向標**，投資者將以此判斷 AI 需求的持續力度；同時，半導體板塊的整體盈利仍在雙位數增長，顯示 AI 熱潮仍是驅動市場的重要因素【NVDA_News_20260519_02.txt, chunk #1】。  

因此，新聞焦點集中在上述四大競爭者的技術與市場布局，以及 Nvidia 作為 AI 晶片領導者在當前 AI 產業熱潮中的指標性角色。

Apple

The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. records.answer:
Tesla 最近的關注焦點主要來自三則新聞：一是 2026 年 7 月 20 日的財報季前分析，二是 2026 年 6 月 12 日即將於 Nasdaq 上市的 SpaceX IPO，三是 2026 年 5 月 18 日 Elon Musk 對 OpenAI 的 1500 億美元訴訟被陪審團全體駁回。  

1. **財報前的市場觀察** – Yahoo Finance 於 2026‑07‑20 發布的影片指出，Tesla（TSLA）當週將公布最新財報，分析師關注的兩大重點包括可能的併購傳聞以及股價近期的低迷（當日股價跌 2.96%）【TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

2. **SpaceX IPO 影響** – 同樣在 2026‑06‑12，Reuters 報導 SpaceX 計畫於 6 月 12 日以每股 135 美元的價格在 Nasdaq 首次公開募股，2025 年虧損 49.4 億美元，目標估值 1.77 兆美元【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。SpaceX 作為 Elon Musk 的核心事業，其上市預期會把投資者的注意力從 Tesla 轉移至太空事業，間接影響 Tesla 的市場情緒。  

3. **Musk 訴訟結果** – 2026‑05‑18 的報導說，陪審團一致駁回 Musk 對 OpenAI（以及對 Microsoft 的相關索賠）的 1500 億美元訴訟，認為其提起訴訟已超過時效，並由聯邦法官正式結案【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1】。此案的高額索賠與最終敗訴，使得媒體與投資者再次聚焦 Musk 本人，進而提升對 Tesla 的關注度。  

以上三則新聞在近期均對 Tesla 的投資者關注與股價波動產生了直接或間接的影響。

records.answer:

- 服務組合的提升直接帶動整體毛利率提升至 47.9%（TTM），較 FY2024 的 46.2% 以及 FY2019 的 38.2% 均有明顯上升，分析指出這主要是因為服務比重上升【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。

records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的股票，主要因為它擁有極高的獲利能力與現金生成力、龐大的生態系統與用戶基礎、持續成長的高毛利服務收入，以及穩健的資本配置與回饋機制【Reference 1, chunk #1】。

- **獲利與現金流**：Apple 的 TTM 毛利率達 47.9%，較 FY2024 的 46.2% 上升；營業利益率為 32.6%，營運現金流利率約 31.1%（三年平均 29.1%）【Reference 2, chunk #5】。其 TTM 自由現金流為 $129.2 billion，足以覆蓋 $7.7 billion 的股息與 $37.0 billion 的回購支出【Reference 2, chunk #5】。公司持有 $146.6 billion 現金與有價證券，淨現金位置正向且持續增長【Reference 2, chunk #5】。

- **服務收入與高毛利**：服務部門的比重提升，使毛利率從 FY2019 的 38.2% 提升至 FY2024 的 46.2%，並在 TTM 進一步升至 47.9%，顯示服務收入的高毛利特性【Reference 2, chunk #5】。分析師指出服務收入正加速，屬於雙位數成長【Reference 1, chunk #1】。

- **生態系統與用戶黏著**：Apple 具備「龐大安裝基礎」與「生態系統鎖定」的優勢，讓用戶在硬體、軟體與服務間形成高度黏著，提升長期營收穩定性【Reference 1, chunk #1】。

- **價格權力與產品升級**：公司在服務與硬體上持續提價，展現出在生態系統內的價格權力；同時 iPhone 最近四季的成長率達 16%，顯示核心產品仍具吸引力【Reference 3, chunk #0】、【Reference 4, chunk #1】。

- **資本回饋與資本配置**：Apple 持續執行大規模的股票回購與股息發放，2026 上半年已回購 $37 billion、發放 $7.7 billion 股息，且保持「紀律化資本配置」的策略【Reference 2, chunk #5】、【Reference 1, chunk #1】。

- **未來成長動能**：AI 整合（如 Siri AI 與 Apple Intelligence）預計提升使用者體驗與服務黏著度，進一步支撐長期營收與利潤增長【Reference 3, chunk #0】、【Reference 5, chunk #0】。

綜合以上財務穩健、服務高毛利、強大生態系統、持續的產品升級與 AI 布局，Apple 被分析師視為「最具韌性且最有利可圖的企業」之一，因而適合作為長期投資標的【Reference 1, chunk #1】。

records.answer:
NVIDIA 最新財報的營收成長速度在提供的資料中未被揭露，故無法直接給出具體成長率【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

然而，與 IREN 的最新 AI 雲端合作案顯示 NVIDIA 正在資料中心布局上取得多項具體進展：

- **五年期 AI Cloud 合約**：NVIDIA 與 IREN 簽訂了價值 **$3.4 billion** 的五年 AI Cloud 合約，合約金額會隨 GPU 部署而分期確認【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **資本投入與股權認購權**：NVIDIA 為此合作提供 **$2.1 billion** 的投資承諾，透過一項五年內可以每股 **$70** 購買最高 **30 million** 普通股的認購權實現【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。

records.query: Apple 目前的毛利率表現如何？加上新聞中 Evercore ISI 最新調升的目標價與評等，市場如何綜合看待這家公司？
records.answer:
Apple 目前的毛利率為 **47.9%（TTM）**，較 FY 2024 的 46.2% 以及 FY 2019 的 38.2% 均有明顯提升，僅次於同業中 SNDK 的 56.0% 毛利率【Reference 1, chunk #5】。  

- **毛利率表現**：TTM 毛利率 47.9% 反映出 Services 佔比上升帶來的高利潤貢獻，且 Apple 的 EBITDA 毛利率 35.4% 也高於大多數同業【Reference 1, chunk #5】。  
- **市場估值與投資者情緒**：Apple 的前瞻 P/E 為 33.5 倍，遠高於大多數硬體同業，顯示市場願意為其 Services 增長與品牌護城河支付溢價【Reference 1, chunk #5】。同時，Apple 的自由現金流（FCF）在 TTM 為 $129.2 billion，FCF 利潤率 22.4%，在同業中領先【Reference 1, chunk #5】。  
- **成長與風險觀點**：過去 12 個月營收年增率為 12.8%，在同業中屬於較低水平，且分析師指出 iPhone 與 Services 的增長可能受到全球監管（App Store 反壟斷）與供應鏈限制的挑戰【Reference 5, chunk #2】。  
- **Evercore ISI 的最新評等**：Evercore ISI 將 Apple 的目標價從 $330 提升至 **$365**，並維持 **Outperform** 評等，理由包括 iPhone 高溢價與即將推出的可摺疊機型等正面因素【Reference 2, chunk #0】。  
- **綜合市場看法**：投資者普遍將 Apple 視為「高品質、現金流強勁」的核心持股，願意接受較高的估值（前瞻 P/E 33.5x、Price‑to‑Cash‑Flow 30.7x），但同時對其增長放緩與監管風險保持謹慎，形成「高估值‑高品質」與「增長‑風險」兩面交織的市場共識【Reference 1, chunk #5】【Reference 5, chunk #2】。

By Juby Babu
May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age

Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於其 **端到端的加速計算平台**，結合了領先的 GPU 硬體、完整的軟體生態與龐大的開發者社群，讓公司能在 AI、資料中心、圖形與自動駕駛等多個高價值市場保持技術領先。  

- **硬體領先**：NVIDIA 以 GPU 為核心，並在資料中心層面與 CPU、DPU、NVLink 交換器、NIC 等組件共同設計，形成「極致協同」的全套硬體解決方案，支援從訓練到推論的所有 AI 工作負載【Reference 20, chunk #20】。  
- **軟體堆疊**：公司擁有 CUDA 開發平台、CUDA‑X 加速函式庫、AI Enterprise、NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整軟體套件，這些軟體與硬體深度整合，提供企業級的生成式 AI、模型微調與安全部署能力【Reference 28, chunk #28】。  
- **平台化策略**：NVIDIA 以「硬體 + 系統 + 軟體 + 演算法 + AI 模型 + 資料」的全棧方式，打造可在資料中心、雲端與邊緣同時運行的加速計算平台，並在 2025 年推出 Blackwell 架構、2026 年推出 Rubin 平台，持續提升每個 Token 的成本效益【Reference 26, chunk #26】【Reference 25, chunk #25】。  
- **開發者與合作夥伴生態**：全球已有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具，NVIDIA 亦透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute、與主要伺服器製造商、雲端服務供應商的合作，擴大技術採用範圍，形成強大的網路效應【Reference 28, chunk #28】。  
- **多元應用領域**：平台支援醫療、電信、製造、金融、汽車等數十億美元的產業，從遊戲圖形到自動駕駛、數位雙生與機器人等皆可使用同一套底層技術，提升客戶黏著度與切入壁壘【Reference 20, chunk #20】【Reference 120, chunk #120】。  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 的護城河來源於其硬體與軟體的深度共設、龐大的開發者與合作夥伴網絡，以及能在多個高成長產業提供統一、可擴展的 AI 加速解決方案。

NVIDIA 通过一套统一的可编程 GPU 架构（包括 CUDA 开发平台、数千种软件库、SDK 与 API）以及完整的硬件‑系统‑软件堆栈，能够在同一底层平台上同时服务数据中心、游戏、专业可视化和汽车四大市场【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

- **统一的 Compute & Networking 与 Graphics 两大业务板块**：Compute & Networking 部分提供面向数据中心的加速计算、网络平台以及 AI 与汽车解决方案；Graphics 部分则提供面向游戏与 PC 的 GeForce GPU 与面向企业工作站的 Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPU【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **同一底层可编程架构**：所有这些产品都基于 NVIDIA 的可编程 GPU 架构，CUDA 能在所有 GPU 上运行，使得同一硬件能够支撑从高性能 AI 训练到实时游戏渲染的不同工作负载【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **完整的软件堆栈提升跨行业价值**：公司提供包括 NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NVIDIA NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等全栈 AI 软件套件，以及数十万开发者使用的 CUDA、库、框架和 API，帮助客户在数据中心、游戏、专业可视化和汽车等场景中快速部署 AI 与图形工作负载【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **生态系统支撑跨市场渗透**：超过 750 万开发者、数千家服务器厂商与云服务提供商、以及与高校、初创企业的合作，使得同一平台能够在各行业形成强大网络效应，进一步巩固其在四大市场的布局【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **硬件多样化但共享核心技术**：在数据中心，NVIDIA 提供 GPU、CPU、DPU 以及 NVLink、InfiniBand 等高速互连；在游戏和专业可视化，提供 GeForce 与 RTX 系列 GPU；在汽车领域，提供自动驾驶与电动车所需的 GPU、软件与平台—all built on the same underlying GPU architecture and software ecosystem【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  

因此，NVIDIA 通过统一的可编程 GPU 核心、跨行业的软件平台以及广泛的合作生态，实现了在同一底层架构上同时布局数据中心、游戏、专业可视化和汽车市场的战略。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入到 Microsoft 365 的核心服務中，將其定位為 AI‑驅動的功能層，藉由在 Office、Windows、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security & Compliance 等產品裡加入 AI 工具與「agentic」情境，提升使用者生產力並推動訂閱收入成長【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。

- 在 **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 中，Copilot 與 Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Windows Commercial（雲端部分）以及 Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security & Compliance 等服務共同提供，形成一個 AI‑加值的生產力平台【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 這一平台的成長依賴 **「在核心產品與服務中加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 場景」**，包括在溝通、協作、分析、安全、合規等多個 AI 商業生產力類別中擴展功能【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- **Microsoft 365 Consumer** 亦將 Copilot 包含在其雲端訂閱服務中，透過 AI 功能提升個人使用者的生產力與創意體驗【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 這樣的整合策略旨在 **擴大已安裝基礎、提升每位使用者的平均收入（ARPU）**，並加速從傳統的本地 Office 授權向以訂閱為主的 Microsoft 365 轉變【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  

總結來說，Microsoft 透過把 Copilot 作為 AI 核心層嵌入 Microsoft 365 的各個產品與服務，既提升功能深度，也為平台帶來新的增長動能。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 通过把 Windows OEM 授权、Windows Commercial 以及 Windows 设备（如 Surface）与 Microsoft 365 云订阅和 Copilot 功能深度绑定，使得使用 Windows 的个人和企业用户自然会迁移到其云端服务和 AI 助手，从而显著提升这些服务的使用率【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #38】。

- **Windows 作为云服务入口**：在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 的收入构成中，专门列出了 “Windows Commercial 的云部分”，说明 Windows 的云授权直接计入云收入【MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **收入增长的驱动因素**：2025 年上半年（截至 12 月 31 日）Microsoft 365 Commercial 云收入增长 17%，其中一大推动力是 “Microsoft 365 E5 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot” 的采用，同时 “Windows Commercial on‑premises 组件” 也对产品收入增长 15% 贡献显著【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #75】。  
- **座位（用户）增长**：Microsoft 365 Commercial 座位数的提升（即付费用户数）直接反映了更多 Windows 用户转为云订阅用户，这一指标被用来衡量业务健康度【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #12】。  
- **Copilot 的渗透**：在同一 10‑Q 报告中，提到 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的收入贡献是云收入增长的关键因素之一，表明通过 Windows 平台部署的 Copilot 功能正推动用户采用 AI 辅助工作流程【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #75】。  
- **设备生态的协同效应**：Surface PC 与 Copilot+ 版本的推出，进一步把硬件使用体验与 AI 助手绑定，鼓励用户在 Windows 设备上使用 Copilot 及相关云服务【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #38】。  

综上所述，Microsoft 依托 Windows 的广泛装机基础、OEM 授权收入以及与 Microsoft 365、Copilot 的功能整合，形成了从操作系统到云服务再到 AI 助手的闭环，显著提升了云端和 Copilot 相关服务的参与度。

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在透過大規模資本支出與股權投資，同時提升 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 能力，並以 Anthropic 的合作為核心之一【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。

- **AI 相關股權與融資**：  
  - 2026 年第一季，Amazon 向 OpenAI 投入 **150 億美元** 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署一份承諾購買額 **350 億美元** 的認購協議，已於 2026 年第二季再投入 **137 億美元**，合計在 2026 年底帳面上記錄 **287 億美元** 的投資【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  
  - 同期，Amazon 於 2026 年第一季向 Anthropic 投入 **50 億美元** 的非投票優先股，並與 Anthropic 簽訂一項最高 **200 億美元** 的融資設施（30 個月後於公開上市或直接上市時到期），目前尚未啟動提款；此外，Amazon 仍保有 **最高 50 億美元** 的未來股權投資選擇權，可在行使後減少該融資額度【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。

- **技術與基礎設施支出**：  
  - Amazon 明確表示，為支援 AI 與機器學習計畫，將持續提升技術與基礎設施支出，預期未來支出會隨基礎設施（包括伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷）增加而上升【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。  
  - 2026 年第二季與截至 2026 年底的六個月，技術與基礎設施成本較去年同期因基礎設施支出上升而 **增加 4.27 億美元**，其中包括與 AWS 相關的能源合約未實現收益【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。  
  - 2025 年全年，因外匯變動，技術與基礎設施成本亦 **增加 3.12 億美元**【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119】。

- **資產與設備擴張**：  
  - AWS 相關的財產與設備淨值從 2025 年底的 **190,055 百萬美元** 增至 2026 年底的 **263,750 百萬美元**，顯示資料中心與伺服器等基礎設施規模大幅擴張【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #57】。  
  - 同期，AWS 的資本支出（含財務租賃）在六個月內從 **916 百萬美元** 提升至 **1,700 百萬美元**，反映出持續的設備投資力度【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #57】。

**綜合來看**，Amazon 的投資策略是：一方面以巨額股權與可轉換票據方式直接參與前沿 AI 初創公司（OpenAI、Anthropic），確保取得先進模型與技術；另一方面透過持續且快速增長的 AWS 基礎設施支出與設備擴張，為雲端 AI 服務提供算力與平台支撐，並預期未來支出將隨 AI/ML 需求持續上升。

Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與整體電商平台上都面臨多項反壟斷與監管風險，包含歐洲稅務挑戰、全球多國的反競爭訴訟，以及針對其雲端服務、會員制度與市場平台的競爭與消費者保護調查【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】。

**AWS 風險**  
- 監管機構正調查 AWS 的雲端服務是否違反競爭或消費者保護規則，Amazon 已表示強烈爭議並將積極抗辯【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】。  
- 2025 年 6 月，Xockets, Inc. 向美國德州西區法院提出兩項專利侵權訴訟，指稱 AWS Nitro 系統侵犯多項美國專利，屬於知識產權相關的法律風險【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 同時，Amazon 亦面臨日益嚴格的資料隱私與數據使用法規審查，這些新興或既有的規範可能增加合規成本並限制 AWS 的營運【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。

**Prime 風險**  
- 監管機構將 Prime 服務納入「店舖運營」的調查範圍，指稱其可能違反競爭相關或消費者保護規定，Amazon 同樣表示將強力抗辯【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】。  
- 相關調查還涉及 Prime 的結構與定價政策，指控其可能構成濫用市場支配地位的行為【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。

**電商（店舖、履約網路、Marketplace）風險**  
- 自 2020 年以來，Amazon 在美國、加拿大與英國遭到多起反壟斷與消費者保護訴訟，指稱包括與供應商及第三方賣家的價格固定、濫用支配地位、垄斷或企圖垄斷、以及不公平的定價與商品展示政策（如 Featured Offers、賣家資料使用、廣告與自有商品推廣）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 這些訴訟要求巨額賠償、三倍賠償金、懲罰性賠償、禁令、結構性改革以及民事罰款，且部分案件已在美國取得部分駁回，但仍有部分指控存續【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 另外，Amazon 亦面臨意大利的稅務挑戰，屬於跨國稅務與合規風險的一環【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】。  

綜合上述，Amazon 必須同時應對 AWS 的專利與資料隱私調查、Prime 的競爭與消費者保護審查，以及其電商平台的價格固定、濫用支配地位與廣告行為等多層面的反壟斷與監管風險。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 已在其 15 款至少擁有 5 億使用者的產品（包括 Search、YouTube、Pixel 裝置與 Workspace 等）中嵌入 Gemini 系列 AI 模型，讓這些服務都能直接使用生成式與多模態 AI 功能【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。

- **Search**：Google 透過 Gemini 3 的先進推理與多模態能力，將 AI Overviews（即在搜尋框直接提供即時回答）與 AI Mode（允許使用者以更自然、複雜的問題互動）內建於搜尋體驗，讓使用者只需一次查詢即可得到更完整的資訊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **Gemini App**：Gemini 3 也被部署在專屬的 Gemini 應用程式中，提供使用者即時的生成式回應與互動式體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Google Workspace & Cloud**：在企業層面，Alphabet 以 Gemini Enterprise 為平台，讓團隊在安全環境中建立、分享與執行 AI 代理人；同時，Gemini for Google Workspace 把 AI 助手帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等生產力工具，協助撰寫、組織與視覺化工作內容【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **Pixel 裝置與其他產品**：Pixel 系列手機與 Pixel Watch 等硬體產品亦內建 Gemini 模型，結合 AI、軟體與硬體提供更智慧的使用者體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  
- **消費者訂閱服務**：Google One 訂閱方案提供使用者存取最先進的 Gemini 模型，進一步將高階 AI 能力帶給一般消費者【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

透過上述多層面的整合，Google 將 Gemini AI 從核心搜尋功能擴展至其整個生態系，涵蓋廣告、雲端、裝置與消費者服務，實現「AI 於每個產品皆可用」的全方位布局。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋在 2025 年的 10‑K 中說明，已透過 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode** 兩項功能，將大型語言模型與多模態 Gemini 3 整合進搜尋體驗，以直接回應生成式 AI 帶來的更複雜查詢需求。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]

- **AI Overviews** 讓使用者只要輸入問題，就能即時得到一段有用的回覆，彷彿在搜尋結果頁面上直接呈現 AI 產生的摘要。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
- **AI Mode** 則允許使用者提出更細緻、需要多步推理的問題，這些問題過去往往需要多次搜尋才能完成，現在透過 Gemini 的「先進推理、思考與多模態」能力一次解答。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  

此演變是 Alphabet 以 **AI‑first** 為核心的全堆疊策略的一環：  
- 公司持續投資 AI‑優化的基礎設施（GPU、TPU 等），並在過去十年開發出 Gemini 系列模型，其中最新的 **Gemini 3** 具備更強的多模態理解與生成能力，已被嵌入搜尋、YouTube、Google Cloud 等產品。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  
- 在開發新功能時，Alphabet 先聚焦「使用者體驗」再考慮「變現」；因此 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 的推出，是先以提升搜尋的自然語言交互與資訊取得速度為目標，之後才會探索相應的廣告或雲端服務收入模式。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196]  

同時，Alphabet 也指出，隨著生成式 AI 產品與服務的競爭加劇，這些新搜尋功能有助於保持 Google 在搜尋廣告收入上的領先地位，並且透過更高效的技術基礎設施（如自研 TPU）降低長期運營成本。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196]

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises. At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Guided by our AI principles, we believe our approach to AI must be both bold and responsible.

Overview

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是以「元宇宙」作為下一代計算平台，透過 AI、穿戴式裝置、虛擬與增強實境等技術持續投入巨額資金，並接受短期內因 Reality Labs 投資而導致的營運虧損【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。

- **AI 投資**：Meta 明確表示會「開發與訓練我們的 AI 模型，並預期持續增加這些投資」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。  
- **Reality Labs 的整體方向**：公司將「在 AI、穿戴式裝置與設備上投入創新，協助打造下一代介面」以支援元宇宙的發展【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  
- **資金分配**：在 2026 年，Meta 計畫將 Reality Labs 營運費用的 **約 70% 用於穿戴式裝置（wearables）**，其餘 **30% 用於虛擬實境（VR）與 Horizon**，此比例基於公司對產品線成本的判斷【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- **財務影響**：Reality Labs 的投資已在 2025 年「減少約 191.9 億美元的整體營運利潤」，且公司預期 2026 年的 Reality Labs 營運虧損「將與 2025 年相似」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。  
- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 承認在消費者硬體、VR/AR 技術方面的經驗相對有限，可能使其他公司更具競爭力；同時，若元宇宙的市場接受度未如預期，或產品與第三方平台的互通性不足，均可能對業務與財務產生不利影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】、【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #168】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  

總結來說，Meta 正以 AI 與 Reality Labs 為核心，長期致力於打造以元宇宙為核心的全新計算平台，並在 2026 年將大部分資源聚焦於穿戴式裝置，同時接受因這些前瞻性投資而產生的短期營運虧損與相關風險。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠在其「Family of Apps」上以每千次展示（CPM）或每次點擊/行動（CPC/CPA）收費的廣告來創造幾乎全部營收，並且 Meta AI 以助理與底層 AI 引擎的形式嵌入所有應用，協助內容排序、推薦、廣告工具以及新一代生成式 AI 體驗。【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】

- **廣告獲利模式**  
  - Meta 的收入「幾乎全部」來自於在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 以及第三方行動應用上銷售廣告版位，廣告客戶根據「展示次數」或「使用者採取的行動」付費【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #27】。  
  - 這些廣告收入在「印象交付」的合約期間內確認，印象被視為已向使用者展示時即認列；若是基於使用者點擊或其他行動的廣告，則在使用者完成該行動的期間內認列【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #84】。  

- **Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**  
  - Meta AI 被描述為「跨應用、獨立應用、AI 眼鏡與網路上皆可使用的助理」，旨在協助使用者「學習、完成任務、創作內容、與他人連結」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - AI 投資支援多項功能：  
    - 為廣告系統提供內容排序模型，提升廣告投放的相關性與效能。  
    - 驅動「發現引擎」以推薦相關內容給使用者。  
    - 為廣告主提供更精準的廣告工具。  
    - 開發生成式 AI 體驗與提升產品開發效率。  
  - 這些 AI 能力遍佈於 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等平台，形成一個以 AI 為核心的生態系統【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

--- Business Summary --- Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc.

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-K period 2025] In particular, we regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. Revenue and Investments

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把全车设计为具备自动驾驶能力的平台，并通过自研 AI 芯片、持续的 OTA 软件升级、以及以 FSD（Supervised）为核心的 Robotaxi 业务，将自动驾驶（FSD/Autopilot）打造成与竞争对手的核心差异化因素【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

- **全车自动驾驶设计**：Tesla 声称“每一辆交付的 Tesla 车辆今天都被设计为具备自动驾驶能力”，并认为其 AI 能力使其在竞争中脱颖而出【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **自研视觉与推理硬件**：公司使用“基于视觉的技术、系统和软件来训练人工神经网络”，并由“自家内部定制的推理芯片”加速，这些专有硬件与软件堆栈是其技术壁垒【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **OTA 软件迭代**：Tesla “通过空中软件更新（over‑the‑air updates）定期改进车辆功能”，使自动驾驶功能能够在不更换硬件的情况下持续提升【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **FSD 订阅与 Robotaxi 业务**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服务使用 Model Y（未来将使用 Cybercab），并计划通过 FSD（Supervised）订阅和 Robotaxi 平台，将 AI、软件和车队利润转化为“以服务为驱动的商业模式”【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **竞争定位**：在 10‑K 中，Tesla 明确指出其将继续在“FSD（Supervised）和神经网络能力、Supercharger 网络以及信息娱乐系统”上取得进展，以在自动驾驶市场中与传统叫车服务和其他竞争者区分【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。  
- **品牌与技术优势**：Tesla 认为其“AI 能力的规格与特性、强大的品牌以及模块化、可扩展的产品设计”赋予了在自动驾驶领域的竞争优势【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。  

综上，Tesla 通过把每辆车都设计为可自动驾驶、投入自研 AI 硬件与软件、利用 OTA 持续升级、并围绕 FSD 订阅和 Robotaxi 构建服务化商业模式，形成了相较于传统汽车制造商和其他 AI/机器人公司的核心差异化。

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨來自傳統汽車製造商、新興電動車廠商以及替代燃料車輛的激烈競爭，同時還必須應對電池供應、原材料價格波動、AI 與自動駕駛技術競爭，以及人才爭奪等多重挑戰。  

- **產品層面的直接競爭**：Tesla 的 Cybertruck、Model S/X、Model 3/Y 分別與傳統皮卡、豪華轎車、豪華 SUV 以及小型至中型轎車與緊湊 SUV 市場的內燃機車型競爭；這些市場已被多家成熟汽車製造商的內燃機車輛所佔據，且越來越多既有與新興廠商已推出或計畫推出電動及其他替代燃料車型，包括混合動力與插電式混合動力車 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]。  

- **供應鏈與原材料風險**：Tesla 目前僅少量合格的電池供應商，供應中斷可能限制車輛與儲能產品的產量；電池成本與大規模生產亦受鋰、鎳等原材料價格與供應不穩的影響，若原材料價格上升或供應不足，將削減盈利空間並可能迫使 Tesla 提高價格或減少產量 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]。  

- **競爭者資源與規模優勢**：許多競爭對手擁有更為成熟或更大規模的資源，可在設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣與售後服務上投入更多資金，進而取得成本效率，這可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格被迫下調、營收短缺、失去客戶與市場份額 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]。  

- **自動駕駛與 AI 競爭**：在自動駕駛與機器人領域，Tesla 必須與其他已具備 AI、機器人技術的公司競爭，其 Robotaxi 服務將與傳統叫車與新興自動駕駛服務爭奪市場份額；同時，競爭者在 AI 與機器人技術上的投入也可能影響 Tesla 的技術領先地位 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44]、[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]。  

- **能源儲存與發電業務的競爭**：Tesla 的能源儲存系統與太陽能發電產品亦面臨來自既有大型公用事業公司、其他能源儲存與發電廠商的價格與性能競爭，這些對手同樣以價格、能量密度、效率與安裝便利性等因素與 Tesla 競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44]。  

- **人才爭奪**：在全球範圍內，特別是工程與製造中心，Tesla 必須與其他汽車與科技公司爭奪具備電動車、AI、機器人等專業技能的人才，人才流失或招聘困難亦可能削弱其競爭力 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #69]。  

綜合以上因素，Tesla 在電動車市場的競爭態勢是多維度且高度激烈，涵蓋產品、市場、供應鏈、技術、能源及人力資源等多個層面。

In addition, certain government and economic incentives which provide benefits to manufacturers who assemble domestically or have local suppliers, may provide a greater benefit to our competitors, which could negatively impact our profitability. Many of our competitors have significantly more or better-established resources than we do to devote to the design, development, manufacturing, distribution, promotion, sale and support of their products and services, and may achieve additional cost efficiencies owing to location and economic environments. Increased competition could result in our lower vehicle unit sales, price reductions, revenue shortfalls, loss of customers and loss of market share, which may harm our business, financial condition and operating results. We also face competition in our energy generation and storage business from other manufacturers, developers, installers and service providers of competing energy technologies, as well as from large utilities. In addition, decreases in the retail or wholesale prices of electricity from utilities or other renewable energy sources could make our products less attractive to customers and lead to an increased rate of customer defaults. Growth of our business is also dependent upon our ability to develop and commercialize Bots, including Optimus, which is in a nascent industry that has yet to develop commercially. 15


We currently are developing Bots, including Optimus, and intend for these products, as well as accompanying services, to be an important part of our business going forward. While this development requires significant cash investments and management resources, there is no guarantee this business will be successful. We have yet to commercialize Bots and cannot predict how demand for Bots will develop, either from commercial or consumer applications. We also face significant competition from other companies that are designing, developing and building robotics applications. Our success will depend on various factors, including our ability to successfully apply our artificial neural network training experience to autonomous robots, to either source or custom develop the necessary technology and components, and the product’s cost-effectiveness, utility and competitive positioning relative to market alternatives. If our Bots program fails to develop as we expect, or progresses more slowly than expected, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. Risks Related to Our Operations

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] If we are not successful in managing these risks, our business, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. Employees may leave Tesla or choose other employers over Tesla due to various factors, such as a very competitive labor market for talented individuals with automotive or technology, including AI, experience, or any negative publicity related to us. In regions where we have or will have operations, particularly significant engineering and manufacturing centers, there is strong competition for individuals with skillsets needed for our business, including specialized knowledge of electric vehicles, engineering and electrical and building construction expertise.

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司整體策略的核心成長支柱，利用汽車技術衍生的電池與軟體能力，擴大清潔能源營收，同時降低客戶取得成本並支撐長期營運增長目標【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **業務定位與客戶範圍**：該業務涵蓋太陽能發電與儲能產品（如 Powerwall、Megapack）以及相關服務，面向住宅、商業、工業客戶與公用事業，透過網站、門市、畫廊及渠道合作夥伴銷售與租賃【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **策略重點**：公司在 2025 年的 10‑K 中明確指出，行銷與銷售這些產品時強調「簡化、標準化與可取得性」，目的是讓客戶更容易且成本更低地採用清潔能源，同時減少客戶取得成本【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #29】。  
- **技術與平台整合**：能源儲存產品共享來自汽車的元件技術，並結合 AI 與軟體平台（Powerhub、Autobidder）實現遠端控制與電網調度，顯示能源業務與車輛事業在硬體與軟體層面高度互補【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- **產品與產能擴張**：2025 年推出 Megapack 3、Megablock 以及新型住宅翻新太陽能板，並在 2026 年初開始交付，顯示公司正透過新產品與產能擴張推動業務成長【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。  
- **營收貢獻**：在 2026 年第一季，能源生成與儲能營收為 $2,408 million，佔當季總營收 $22,387 million 的約 10.8%，較 2025 年第一季的 $2,730 million 稍有下降，但仍是公司收入的重要組成部分【TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #12】。  
- **長期增長依賴**：10‑Q 中指出，該業務的長期成功取決於「逐步的量能增長」與持續擴大產能，以滿足高需求，並確保電池供應不成瓶頸，這與公司整體的未來增長藍圖相呼應【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。

綜合以上，能源生成與儲能不僅是獨立的清潔能源產品線，更是與汽車事業技術、AI 軟體與全球銷售網路深度結合的戰略要素，為 Tesla 提供多元化收入、加速規模化與提升品牌使命（加速全球向可持續能源過渡）的關鍵支撐。
contexts: [TSLA] The company operates in two segments, Automotive; and Energy Generation and Storage. The company offers electric vehicles, as well as sells automotive regulatory credits; and non-warranty maintenance services and collision, automotive insurance services, as well as part sales and retail merchandise sale. It also provides sedans and sport utility vehicles through direct and used vehicle sales, a network of Tesla Superchargers, and in-app upgrades; purchase financing and leasing services; services for electric vehicles through its company-owned service locations and Tesla mobile service technicians; and vehicle limited warranties and extended service plans. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and leasing of solar energy generation and energy storage products, and related services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers and utilities through its website, stores, and galleries, as well as through a network of channel partners. Further, it provides services and repairs to its energy product customers, including under warranty and extended service plans; and various financing options to its residential customers; lithium-ion battery energy storage products, such as Powerwall and Megapack; energy generation products, including solar panels and solar roof; self-driving development and artificial intelligence software, vehicle control and infotainment software, and battery and powertrain. The company was formerly known as Tesla Motors, Inc. and changed its name to Tesla, Inc. in February 2017. Tesla, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We also customize solutions including our energy storage products, energy generation systems and/or Solar Roof for customers to meet their specific needs. 4


Sales and Marketing

Historically, we have been able to achieve sales without relying on traditional advertising and at relatively low marketing costs. We continue to monitor our public narrative and brand, and tailor our marketing efforts accordingly, including through investments in customer education and advertising as necessary. Automotive

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Where possible, we co-locate Superchargers with our solar and energy storage systems to reduce costs and promote renewable power. Supercharger stations are typically placed along well-traveled routes and in and around dense city centers to allow vehicle owners the ability to enjoy quick, reliable charging along an extensive network with convenient stops. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. We offer Supercharger access to non-Tesla vehicles in support of our mission, with all major automakers announcing their adoption of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) in certain markets. We continue to monitor and increase our network of Tesla Superchargers in anticipation of future demand, including with respect to our Robotaxi services. We also work with a wide variety of hospitality, retail and public destinations, as well as businesses with commuting employees, to offer additional charging options for our customers, as well as single-family homeowners and multi-family residential entities, to deploy home charging solutions. To accelerate dependable charging ubiquity, Superchargers are also available through our Supercharger for Business program, where third parties can purchase and install Superchargers and set the charging price, while Tesla remains responsible for software updates, network operations, maintenance and driver support. In 2025, we opened the first Tesla Diner in California, which offers Supercharging as well as Tesla themed food and merchandise. In-App Upgrades 

As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. Energy Generation and Storage

We market and sell our solar and energy storage products to residential, commercial and industrial customers and utilities through a variety of channels, including through our website, stores and galleries, as well as through our network of channel partners, and in the case of some commercial customers, through PPA transactions. We emphasize simplicity, standardization and accessibility to make it easy and cost-effective for customers to adopt clean energy, while reducing our customer acquisition costs. 5


Service and Warranty

Automotive

Service

We provide service for our electric vehicles at our company-owned service locations and through Tesla Mobile Service technicians who perform work remotely at customers’ homes or other locations. Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. The connectivity of our vehicles also allows us to diagnose and remedy many problems remotely and proactively. Vehicle Limited Warranties and Extended Service Plans

We provide a manufacturer’s limited warranty on all new and used Tesla vehicles we sell directly to consumers, which may include limited warranties on certain components, specific types of damage or battery capacity retention. We also currently offer optional extended service plans that provide coverage after the new vehicle limited warranties end for certain models in specified regions. Energy Generation and Storage

We provide service and repairs to our energy product customers, including under warranty where applicable. We generally provide manufacturer’s limited warranties with our energy storage products and offer certain extended limited warranties that are available at the time of purchase of the system. If we install a system, we also provide certain limited warranties on our installation workmanship. For retrofit energy generation systems, we provide separate limited warranties for workmanship and against roof leaks, and for Solar Roof, we also provide limited warranties for defects and weatherization. For components not manufactured by us, we generally pass-through the applicable manufacturers’ warranties.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

[TSLA 10-Q period 202606] [section: Automotive and AI Enabled Products—Production] Our new products, production capacity, infrastructure investments and advances in autonomy and robotics, position us for future growth. 29


As our vehicle production increases, we must work constantly to similarly increase vehicle delivery capability so that it does not become a bottleneck on our total deliveries. As we expand our manufacturing operations and vehicle lineup globally, we will also have to continue to increase and staff our delivery, servicing and charging infrastructure accordingly, maintain our vehicle reliability and optimize our Supercharger locations to ensure cost effectiveness and customer satisfaction. In particular, as other automotive manufacturers have announced their adoption of NACS and agreements with us to utilize our Superchargers, we must correspondingly expand our network in order to ensure adequate availability to meet customer demands. We have also begun deploying public Megachargers in preparation for the production of Tesla Semi. In addition, we remain focused on continued enhancements of the capability and efficiency of our servicing operations. In tandem with the launch of our Robotaxi business, we are focused on developing and optimizing dedicated infrastructure, including in relation to vehicle cleaning and maintenance, charging, security, teleoperations and fleet management, to ensure service quality as we continue to scale. Energy Generation and Storage Demand, Production and Deployment

The long-term success of this business is dependent upon incremental volume growth. We continue to increase the production and capabilities of our energy storage products to meet high levels of demand, including the ramps of our Megafactories in Shanghai and Lathrop, California, and the construction of a new Megafactory near Houston, Texas. In 2025, we introduced Megapack 3 and Megablock, our next-generation industrial storage product, and began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel. For Megapack, energy storage deployments can vary meaningfully quarter to quarter depending on the timing of specific project milestones and logistics.

As these product lines grow, we will have to maintain adequate battery cell supply for our energy storage products.

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中直言，儘管它設計並整合了硬體、作業系統與服務，但在智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置等主要市場只佔「少數」市佔，且必須面對資源充沛、行銷與分銷能力強大的競爭者的激烈壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

- Apple 認為競爭者在技術、行銷、分銷與成本結構上具備顯著優勢，常以 aggressive pricing（激進降價）與低利潤策略來爭奪市場，導致整體毛利率受到向下壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 競爭者不僅模仿 Apple 的產品功能與設計，甚至嘗試在自家產品中整合類似的元件與服務，以提供「整合解決方案」來削弱 Apple 的差異化優勢【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 市場特性包括價格敏感、產品生命週期短、技術標準快速演變，以及新產品與服務的頻繁推出，這些都加劇了 Apple 必須持續創新與快速上市的挑戰【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 由於 Apple 在上述四大類別的全球市佔屬於「少數」，這會使第三方開發者較不願投入資源開發或維護其平台的軟體與服務，進一步影響產品吸引力與需求【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  

總結來說，Apple 在 10‑K 中描述自己在智慧型手機、PC、平板與穿戴裝置市場面臨「激烈的價格與技術競爭」以及「僅有少數市場份額」的雙重壓力，且這些因素相互影響，可能削弱其產品需求與開發者生態系統的健康度。
contexts: [AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. Supply of Components

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa. Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Rest of Asia Pacific includes Australia, New Zealand and those Asian countries not included in the Company’s other reportable segments. Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 2

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 7

Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

While these arrangements can lower operating costs, they also reduce the Company’s direct control over production and distribution.

The Company’s future performance depends in part on support from third-party software developers. The Company believes decisions by customers to purchase its hardware products depend in part on the availability of third-party software applications and services. Third-party developers may discontinue the development and maintenance of software applications and services for the Company’s products. If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products, adversely impacting the Company’s business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company believes that third-party developer support depends on the perceived benefits of creating software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. Failure to obtain or create digital content that appeals to the Company’s customers, or to make such content available on commercially reasonable terms, could have a material adverse impact on the Company’s business, results of operations and financial condition. The Company contracts with numerous third parties to offer their digital content to customers. This includes the right to sell, or offer subscriptions to, third-party content, as well as the right to incorporate specific content into the Company’s own services. The licensing or other distribution arrangements for this content can be for relatively short time periods and do not guarantee the continuation or renewal of these arrangements on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Some third-party content providers and distributors currently or in the future may offer competing products and services, and can take actions to make it difficult or impossible for the Company to license or otherwise distribute their content. Other content owners, providers or distributors may seek to limit the Company’s access to, or increase the cost of, such content. The Company may be unable to continue to offer a wide variety of content at commercially reasonable prices with acceptable usage rules. The Company also produces its own digital content, which can be costly to produce due to intense and increasing competition for talent, content and subscribers, and may fail to appeal to the Company’s customers. The Company’s success depends largely on the talents and efforts of its team members, the continued service and availability of highly skilled employees, including key personnel, and the Company’s ability to nurture its distinctive and inclusive culture. Much of the Company’s future success depends on the talents and efforts of its team members and the continued availability and service of key personnel, including its Chief Executive Officer, executive team and other highly skilled employees. Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 之所以能讓第三方開發者在 iOS、生態系統中保持黏著，主要是因為開發者認為在 Apple 的 App Store 及其整合的硬體‑軟體平台上能獲得可觀的收入機會與用戶基礎，儘管相較於 Android、Windows 等平台的市場佔有率較小，仍透過高額的佣金結構、專屬工具與歐盟 DMA 相關的替代收費與分發方式來維持吸引力。  

- Apple 認為開發者會比較「在 Apple 平台上開發與在 Android、Windows 等競爭平台上開發的收益與成本」來決定是否投入資源；因此公司必須依靠其產品的市場定位與預期營收來提升開發者的感知利益，否則較低的全球手機、PC、平板與穿戴設備市佔率會使開發者傾向於競爭對手平台【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  
- Apple 透過 App Store 向第三方應用與數位服務收取佣金，這是開發者持續在 iOS、生態系統內發佈產品的主要收入來源；若開發者改用直接‑消費者分發或其他支付方式，Apple 可能失去佣金，進而影響其營收與毛利，故公司有動機提供有競爭力的分潤條件以維持開發者黏著【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。  
- 為了因應歐盟《數位市場法》（DMA）而推出的「替代費率結構」與「替代分發方式」，Apple 在 iOS、iPadOS、App Store 以及 Safari 中加入新商業條款，讓開發者在歐洲市場仍能以較低成本或不同模式上架，藉此降低因法規限制而流失開發者的風險【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #63】。  
- 同時，文件指出 Apple 的「少數市場佔有率」會讓開發者較不願意為其產品開發或升級軟體，因為他們可能將資源投入市佔率較大的 Android 或 Windows 平台，這是 Apple 必須持續透過生態系統整合與財務激勵來克服的挑戰【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #59】。  

總結來說，Apple 透過提供高價值的用戶基礎、App Store 佣金收入、以及因應法規的替代收費與分發機制，來彌補其相對較低的市場佔有率，從而在開發者生態系中建立並維持黏著度。

In addition, the DMA imposes interoperability obligations on the Company requiring it to make certain of its technologies and features available to third-party products and services for free, which increases security and privacy risks, requires significant engineering resources, and can adversely affect the functionality, competitiveness, and user experience of the Company’s products. Interoperability and other requirements have in the past, and may in the future, cause the Company to not launch or maintain products, services and features, such as Siri AI, in certain jurisdictions. records.answer:
Microsoft Azure’s revenue grew **about 40 % year‑over‑year in the most recent quarter (the three months ended March 31 2026)**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】.

- This 40 % increase reflects the latest quarterly performance of Azure within Microsoft’s Intelligent Cloud segment.

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
In the most recent quarter (the three‑months ended 31 Mar 2026), Microsoft’s **More Personal Computing** segment revenue **declined 1%**, a drop of **$179 million** versus the same quarter a year earlier【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】.  

- **Windows and Devices** revenue fell **$103 million (‑2%)**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】.  
- **Gaming** revenue fell **$380 million (‑7%)**, driven by lower Xbox hardware sales and weaker Xbox content and services【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】.  
- **Search advertising** revenue **rose $304 million (＋9%)**, partially offsetting the hardware‑related declines【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】.

Amazon AWS 部門在最新一季（2026 Q2，截至 2026‑06‑30 的三個月）營業利益的成長主要是因為 **銷售額大幅上升**，而這一增長被對技術基礎設施的投入所部分抵消，匯率變動對本季營業利益影響不大【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #85】。

- 具體而言，AWS 的營業收入在 Q2 2026 提升了 **37 %**（從 30,873 百萬美元增至 42,232 百萬美元），是推動營業利益增長的核心動力【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #74】。  
- 同期，AWS 的營業費用也上升（從 20,713 百萬美元增至 25,611 百萬美元），主要是為了支撐快速增長的雲端服務需求而增加的 **技術與基礎設施支出**，因此抵消了部分營業利益的提升【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #85】。  
- 匯率變動對 Q2 2026 的 AWS 營業利益「沒有顯著影響」【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #85】。  

因此，AWS 營業利益的增長可歸因於 **銷售快速增長**，同時伴隨著 **技術基礎設施投資的成本上升**，而匯率因素影響有限。

Google Cloud’s revenue jumped by $11.1 billion year‑over‑year in the latest quarter, an **82 % increase** over the same quarter a year earlier【Reference 4, chunk #111】.  

- For the three months ended June 30 2025, Google Cloud generated **$13,624 million** in revenue【Reference 3, chunk #91】.  
- For the three months ended June 30 2026 (the most recent quarter), revenue rose to **$24,768 million**【Reference 3, chunk #91】.  
- The $11.1 billion rise (from $13.6 billion to $24.8 billion) represents the 82 % growth cited in the executive overview【Reference 4, chunk #111】.

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 為收購雲端安全平台 Wiz 支付了 **$29.5 billion**，且此筆收購被歸入 Google Cloud 部門，預計提升其多雲與 AI 驅動的安全能力【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。

- 收購於 2026 年 3 月 11 日完成，金額已扣除後續調整與補償安排，屬於 Google Cloud 為加速多雲與 AI 安全所作的投資【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 完成收購後，Wiz 的財務結果已納入合併財務報表，並列入 Google Cloud 事業部的收入與成本中【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 收購價格中分配的 **$22.7 billion 商譽** 亦記錄於 Google Cloud 部門，主要反映預期的協同效益，雖不具稅務可扣除性，但會在該部門的資產負債表上顯示【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 這筆投資被公司描述為「加速我們在多雲與 AI‑驅動安全方面的能力」，因此預期會增強 Google Cloud 在企業安全市場的競爭力【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  

簡言之，Google 以 $29.5 billion 完成 Wiz 收購，並將其財務與商譽全部計入 Google Cloud 部門，以提升該部門的多雲與 AI 安全服務。
